name: preview_app
description: Publish a workspace web app as a live Matrix preview. Pass only the app directory. The system detects the runtime and framework, uploads the project, installs all required dependencies including development tools, starts the server, verifies the public custom URL, and returns either an explicit success with preview_url or an exact stage-specific error. Never edit the app, change package scripts, or run installation commands yourself in response to a preview failure; report the returned error verbatim. args: app_directory

app_directory.description: Absolute path inside /workspace, or a path relative to /workspace, containing the web app.
